text: In Simplicial TT, the directed interval 2 = {0,1} gives rise to arrows. An element of type hom_A(a,b) (the hom-type) is interpreted as:
choices: A path from a to b in A
A morphism from a to b in the (∞,1)-category A
A homotopy equivalence from a to b
explanation: hom_A(a,b) = A^2 restricted to functions sending 0↦a and 1↦b; these are 1-morphisms.
